name: Beach Donkey Plush
desc: A soft grey donkey with a hat, won from a claw machine on the Golden Mile. It has no cash value whatsoever, which is the whole point of a prize.

name: Tower Teddy
desc: A small bear in a tiny Blackpool Tower jumper. Won on the seafront, which is where bears with jumpers belong.

name: Pier Gull Plush
desc: A plush seagull with a stitched chip in its beak. Far better behaved than the real thing, and it won't take yours.

name: Pebble Pal
desc: A soft toy shaped like a Brighton beach pebble, with a face. Comfier than the real beach, and nobody has ever said otherwise.
